12.1/CR3 Tender – 9 Leeway Court, Osborne Park Roof and HVAC
Responsible Officer: Manager Property Services
Purpose
To consider the outcome of the request for tender for roof and HVAC replacement works at
9 Leeway Court, Osborne Park.
Background
Tender Deadline: Monday 21 September 2026
Four submissions were received and evaluated in accordance with Regulation 18 of the Local
Government (Functions and General) Regulations 1996.
Officer's Recommendation
That the tender from Kardan Australia Pty Ltd for 9 Leeway Court, Osborne Park Roof and
HVAC in the lump sum amount of $1,064,854 (ex GST) be accepted.
=====PAGE=====
Council Resolution
Moved Cr Example A, Seconded Cr Example B
That the tender from Kardan Australia Pty Ltd for 9 Leeway Court, Osborne Park Roof and
HVAC in the lump sum amount of $1,064,854 (ex GST) be accepted.
CARRIED 13/0

12.2/IS1 Erindale Road Resurfacing – Budget Amendment
Purpose
To amend the 2026-27 budget to bring forward resurfacing works.
Officer's Recommendation
That Council APPROVES a budget amendment of $180,000 for the resurfacing of Erindale Road
between Beach Road and Karrinyup Road, Hamersley, funded from the Road Renewal Reserve.
Council Resolution
Moved Cr Example C, Seconded Cr Example D
That Council APPROVES a budget amendment of $180,000 for the resurfacing of Erindale Road
between Beach Road and Karrinyup Road, Hamersley, funded from the Road Renewal Reserve.
CARRIED BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY 13/0

12.3/CR4 Community Garden Licence – Inglewood
Purpose
To grant a licence to a community group for a garden on a reserve.
Officer's Recommendation
That Council grants a five year licence to the Inglewood Community Garden Group.
Council Resolution
That the recommendation be adopted.
CARRIED 13/0
